title: nb audit: results_since can never list new results of the cited experiments
body:
Found in the spec-vs-code review of branch `worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce` on 2026-11-09. Line numbers are that branch.

SPEC (Audit): the bundle includes "results added to those experiments, or with links to the same hypotheses and questions, since the node was created".

`bin/nb` builds `results_since` with `if r not in uncited`, and `uncited` is every non-cited result of those experiments. A later result of a cited experiment appears under uncited results with nothing marking it as newer than the node. Reproduced by a reviewer.

Also, by reading only: the comparison is on dates (`created >= n["created"]`), so a same-day result recorded before the node counts as since.
